xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2607: chore(beads): PAN-2564 landing follow-ups — myn 4-store reconcile, server typecheck gate, comparator/report polish

plan.title: chore(beads): PAN-2564 landing follow-ups — myn 4-store reconcile, server typecheck gate, comparator/report polish
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: The PAN-2564 Dolt-native cutover shipped, but the landing exposed seven follow-up gaps: (1) mind-your-now has four bead stores (frontend/.beads=131 incl. live min-865, api/.beads=33, canonical state worktree=23, retired empty root DB) and the reconcile tool can only compare three fixed sources — myn cannot be safely consolidated or published; (2) src/dashboard/server is excluded from root typecheck AND root npm run build does not build the server bundle, so a yield*-outside-generator PARSE error shipped through green gates; (3) flywheel.ts:170/:328 and start.ts:621 still run execFileSync('bd') per issue/workspace instead of one bulk resolver read; (4) the reconcile comparator classified all 3253 records 'conflicting' because the v53 migration bumped updated_at on every row, making the report unreadable; (5) that same mass-reset pollutes every recency signal built on bead updated_at; (6) beads-cutover.json validation only accepts 40-hex git SHAs while local Dolt heads are 32-char base32.
narratives.Proposal: Eight independent beads. Comparator: bucket updated_at-only diffs as 'metadata-drift' and add per-classification summary counts to the report. Multi-store: generalize reconcileBeads to N named sources via a repeatable --store <name>=<path> CLI flag and tolerate an unpublished refs/dolt/data remote. Then run the extended reconcile for mind-your-now (read-only) and write a merge-plan recommendation for operator review. Gate: add npm run build:dashboard:server:bundle to CI and to the live ~/.overdeck/projects.yaml quality gates (bundle build is green in ~2s; full server typecheck has 152 pre-existing errors — filed as follow-up debt, not fixed here). Flywheel/CLI: lift the existing issuesWithBeadsBounded bulk-read helper into a shared lib module and use it at flywheel.ts:170/:328; switch the start.ts spawn gate to the existing async retry resolver. Marker: widen localReconciledHead to also accept 32-char base32 Dolt heads (remoteDoltHead stays a git SHA — it is compared against git ls-remote). Docs: record the 2026-07-12 updated_at mass-reset in docs/BEADS.md and cross-reference it on PAN-2602.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Executing the myn merge plan, wiring the myn Dolt remote, publishing refs/dolt/data for mind-your-now, or writing a myn beads-cutover.json — all gated behind operator review of the reconcile report (approval.json approved:false)
- Fixing the 152 pre-existing src/dashboard/server tsc errors — follow-up issue only
- Changing the backlog routes' 8s-bound degraded mode under bd contention (issue item 7) — deferred to the PAN-2602 read-model rollup
- Mutating, importing into, or deleting any of the four myn bead stores
- Adding a full tsc typecheck gate for src/dashboard/server in this issue
- Changing bd itself or the Dolt storage backend

autoDecisions.summary: Server gate = bundle build (npm run build:dashboard:server:bundle), not full server typecheck.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue offers both ('server typecheck (or build:dashboard:server)'). tsc -p src/dashboard/server has 152 pre-existing errors (verified during planning); the incident class was a parse error, which the tsdown bundle build catches; the bundle build is green today in ~2s. Debt is filed as a follow-up issue instead of ballooning this chore across ~20 files.

autoDecisions.summary: myn deliverable stops at reviewed report + written recommendation; no publish/marker/merge execution.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue mandates 'Do NOT publish refs/dolt/data for myn before this reconcile' and calls for review of the merge plan. The existing approval.json approved:false gate is the operator checkpoint; autonomous work must not cross it.

autoDecisions.summary: Widen only localReconciledHead to accept Dolt-native 32-char base32 heads; keep remoteDoltHead 40-hex.
autoDecisions.rationale: validateBeadsCutoverMarker compares remoteDoltHead against git ls-remote refs/dolt/data output, which is always a git SHA; widening it would break validation semantics. Both schema-widening and documentation are delivered (the issue offered either).

autoDecisions.summary: Issue item 7 (backlog degraded mode) deferred to PAN-2602.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue itself says the current degrade is 'fine for a hint surface' and names the PAN-2602 read-model rollup as the durable fix.

autoDecisions.summary: Bulk beads presence is derived from bead labels via one canonical-store getAllBeads() read, reusing the issuesWithBeadsBounded pattern.
autoDecisions.rationale: That exact derivation already runs in production for the backlog routes (src/dashboard/server/routes/backlog.ts:53-66); post-PAN-2564 all workspace .beads redirect to the canonical home, so per-workspace reads are redundant.

autoDecisions.summary: metadata-drift applies to records present in all sources whose serialized difference is confined to updated_at.
autoDecisions.rationale: The v53 migration bumped updated_at on every row; only-updated_at drift is provably migration noise, while any other field difference remains a real 'conflicting' record.

autoDecisions.summary: The retired empty myn root DB is noted in the recommendation, not added as a reconcile source.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue states it is empty and retired; an empty source adds no records to audit and would only pad the report.

narrative.Action: Using the bead reconcile-multi-store's extended CLI, run: `pan admin beads reconcile mind-your-now --store frontend=/home/eltmon/Projects/myn/frontend --store api=/home/eltmon/Projects/myn/api`. Expected source counts per the issue: frontend/.beads ~131 records (holds live min-865's beads), api/.beads ~33, canonical state worktree (/home/eltmon/.overdeck/state/mind-your-now) ~23, remote refs/dolt/data not published. Then write a companion recommendation note at /home/eltmon/.overdeck/state/mind-your-now/notes/beads-reconcile-<date>-recommendation.md that: (a) summarizes overlap/conflict findings from the report, (b) lays out the two merge-plan options from the issue — single canonical DB vs bd multi-repo routing — with the polyrepo context (13 workspace redirects were rewritten to the canonical path before the polyrepo topology was understood; the original per-workspace mapping for 11 inactive workspaces is gone; live min-865/min-874 point at frontend), (c) makes a concrete recommendation grounded in the observed record distribution, and (d) notes the retired empty root DB. STRICT READ-ONLY: this bead must not run bd migrate/bd sync/bd import, must not push or publish refs/dolt/data for mind-your-now, must not write a beads-cutover.json, and must not modify any of the four stores. The deliverable ends at the report + approval.json (approved: false, written by reconcileBeads) + recommendation; the operator reviews and executes the merge plan separately.

items.title: Write new-workspace beads redirects to the resolved canonical home, never a chained redirect

expected_outputs: worktree-beads-redirect.test.ts suite is green
typecheck completes without errors

narrative.Action: Bug discovered live during PAN-2607 planning: src/lib/workspace-manager/worktree-ops.ts:111-130 writes <worktree>/.beads/redirect pointing at <repoPath>/.beads, but post-PAN-2564 the repo-root .beads itself contains a redirect to the canonical home (the state worktree), and bd refuses redirect chains ('Warning: redirect chains not allowed'). Result: every workspace created after the cutover gets a broken beads store — bd operates on the repo-root .beads stub, `bd bootstrap` fails with 'Error 1007: can't create database overdeck; database exists', and every mutation batch (e.g. pan plan finalize bead creation) fails with 'The mutation batch failed before push'. Fix: in worktree-ops.ts, compute the redirect target via resolveCanonicalBeadsHome(repoPath) from src/lib/beads/home.ts (which returns the state-worktree .beads for a migrated project, or <project.path>/.beads otherwise); when it returns a non-null existing directory, write the redirect content as that ABSOLUTE path; only fall back to the current relative(targetPath, repoPath/.beads) form when the resolver returns null. Apply the same resolution to the polyrepo path in create.ts:258-273, which today silently SKIPS writing a redirect when the subrepo store itself holds a redirect (line 269's !existsSync(join(repoBeadsDir,'redirect')) guard) — leaving bd to spin up an empty database; instead resolve through that redirect and point the workspace at the final target. Never write a redirect whose target directory itself contains a redirect file. Add tests/unit/lib/workspace/worktree-beads-redirect.test.ts (fs fixtures in a temp dir, no real bd calls) covering: migrated project => redirect content is the canonical absolute path; unmigrated project => relative repo .beads path preserved; pre-existing redirect file untouched; polyrepo source store holding a redirect => workspace redirect points at the resolved final target.

items.title: Given a migrated project, worktree creation writes a .beads/redirect that contains the canonical beads home (state-worktree) absolute path rather than the repo-root .beads
Given an unmigrated project, worktree creation preserves the existing relative repo .beads redirect behavior
Given a polyrepo subrepo whose .beads holds a redirect, workspace creation resolves through it and the workspace redirect contains the final target (no redirect chain is ever written)
When bd runs in a freshly created workspace of a migrated project, it emits no redirect-chain warning and bootstrap exits 0
